summary: Russia launched a large-scale drone assault across multiple Ukrainian oblasts overnight, with jet drones tracked over Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk regions, originating from Crimea and Donetsk. Heavy combat continues in the Slovyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration where Russian forces are infiltrating Kostiantynivka and threatening Chasiv Yar. Bloomberg reports Russia is preparing to escalate ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv as peace talks stall, while Budanov warned Patriot ammunition shortages will worsen in 2026.
key_points: Bloomberg reports Russia is preparing to intensify ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv's center and infrastructure in other major Ukrainian cities as peace talks stall. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32774)
Budanov stated Patriot system ammunition deliveries in 2026 will be less than in 2025 and insufficient to withstand the pace of Russian attacks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32745)
Zelensky announced two new groupings will strengthen Ukrainian positions in the Donetsk region, led by Denys Prokopenko and Andriy Biletsky. (Source: @UkraineNow/83705)
DeepState reports Russian forces are actively infiltrating Kostiantynivka and surrounding Chasiv Yar with envelopment maneuvers, amid a change in 11th Corps leadership. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23779)
Multiple jet drones were tracked across Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Vinnytsia, and Odesa oblasts, with launches originating from Crimea and Donetsk. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71086)
Reuters reports all main Lukoil refineries in Russia have been disabled, with Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez halting processing after an August 26 attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/83712)

Ukrainian authorities ordered evacuation of children from nine villages in Zaporizhzhia region within 30 days, located south of Zaporizhzhia between Kamyshevakha and Orekhovoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32767)
A preliminary strike was reported on warehouse premises in Kalynivka, Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71071)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a large-scale overnight drone assault across at least seven Ukrainian oblasts with jet drones tracked over Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk regions, with launches reported from Crimea and Donetsk. Heavy combat continues in the Slovyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration where Russian forces are infiltrating Kostiantynivka and threatening Chasiv Yar. Bloomberg reports Russia is preparing to escalate ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv as peace talks stall, while Budanov warned Patriot ammunition shortages will worsen in 2026.

points: Zelensky announced two new military groupings will strengthen Ukrainian positions in the Donetsk region, to be led by Denys Prokopenko and Andriy Biletsky, during a visit to Zaporizhzhia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83705)

Bloomberg reports Russia is preparing to escalate attacks on Ukraine, likely intensifying ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv including the capital's center and infrastructure in other major cities as peace talks stall. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32774)

DeepState reports the most active fighting in the Slovyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration is around Kostiantynivka, where Russian forces are conducting active infiltration into the city after taking Illinivka, with Ukrainian forces conducting continuous clearing operations of enemy troops hiding in buildings and basements. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23779)

Multiple jet drones were tracked over Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, and Vinnytsia oblasts overnight, with one drone reportedly striking warehouse premises in Kalynivka, Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71071)

Ukrainian authorities ordered the evacuation of children from nine villages in Zaporizhzhia region within 30 days, including Belenky Pervye, Lysogorka, Novotroitske, Golube, Veseloe, Zhelta Krucha, Novorozovka, and Slavne, located south of Zaporizhzhia between Kamyshevakha and Orekhovoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32767)

Russia launched jet drones from Crimea and Donetsk, with multiple drones tracked across Kyiv, Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts overnight, targeting areas including Kyiv's Bortnychi, Osokorky, and Boryspil districts. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71086)

sections.threat_assessment: The operational picture suggests Russia is entering a phase of intensified combined arms strikes against Ukrainian urban centers and critical infrastructure. Bloomberg's reporting on imminent ballistic missile escalation against Kyiv's center, combined with the overnight saturation drone attack across at least seven oblasts, indicates a deliberate campaign to degrade Ukrainian air defense and civil resilience. The Patriot ammunition shortfall acknowledged by Budanov compounds this vulnerability, as Ukrainian air defenders must increasingly prioritize high-value targets over civilian areas. On the ground, the infiltration tactics observed in Kostiantynivka combined with the envelopment threat to Chasiv Yar suggest Russian forces are preparing conditions for a larger offensive toward the last major Donbas cities of Slovyansk and Kramatorsk.
sections.regional_response: The broader regional security implications were highlighted by the reported GRU-linked drone discovered near a Ukrainian cargo plane at Leipzig/Halle Airport on August 4, which US intelligence assesses bears hallmarks of Russian military intelligence devices. This incident, part of 18 drone-related disruptions at the airport since early 2026, suggests Russia is expanding its sabotage campaign into NATO territory to disrupt arms supply chains to Ukraine. Meanwhile, Armenia's National Security Council Secretary Alen Simonyan stated Armenia will not hinder Russians fleeing mobilization, indicating growing discomfort in Moscow's near-abroad with Russian wartime policies. Belarus is constructing a new military polygon with railway infrastructure in Gomel Oblast near the Ukrainian border, where the 37th Separate Air Assault Brigade of Belarusian SSO will be deployed to reinforce the southern axis.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of the Bloomberg escalation warning, the Budanov Patriot shortage admission, and the multi-oblast drone barrage overnight is consistent with a coordinated Russian campaign to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses ahead of anticipated peace negotiations. The deployment of two new Ukrainian groupings under Prokopenko and Biletsky to the Donetsk sector, combined with the 11th Corps leadership change, indicates Kyiv recognizes the severity of the threat to the Slovyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration and is taking structural corrective action. The reported disabling of all main Lukoil refineries represents a significant degradation of Russian domestic refining capacity that may influence Kremlin war-sustaining calculations, though the absence of specific damage assessments limits analysis of operational impact on fuel availability for Russian forces.
